entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and feared death-mage over a century old, bound by a demonic contract for her soul, who comes to Innistrad to destroy her remaining demon masters.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A powerful demon lord and one of Liliana's four demonic creditors, destroyed by her with the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A powerful demon lord worshipped by the Skirsdag cult, missing since around the time the archangel Avacyn disappeared, and one of Liliana's demon masters.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An archangel who disappeared around the same time as Griselbrand.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A towering nature-mage and planeswalker whom Liliana defeated with the Chain Veil, leaving him weakened and cursed, and who is sworn to hunt her.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: A powerful artifact Liliana retrieved from ancient catacombs and used to defeat Garruk and destroy Kothophed.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A secret cult that worships Griselbrand.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who intruded on Liliana's place in Magic 2012.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A foggy, undead-infested plane with almost no angels, where Liliana comes to hunt the remaining demon masters.

entities.name: Demon contract
entities.description: Liliana's contract with four archdemons, trading one soul for necromantic power and long life, etched onto her skin.

events.summary: Liliana retrieves the Chain Veil from ancient catacombs, runs afoul of Garruk Wildspeaker, and defeats him, leaving him cursed.
events.quote: Liliana also learned the grim potency of the Chain Veil, using it to defeat Garruk, leaving him weakened and afflicted with some sort of dark curse.

events.summary: Liliana destroys the demon Kothophed with the power of the Veil, but the contract's etchings stay on her skin.
events.quote: She summoned up all her strength, made even more potent by the power of the Veil, and destroyed the demon Kothophed

events.summary: Liliana travels to Innistrad to hunt her three remaining demon masters.
The column reveals that Griselbrand is one of Liliana's demon masters and has gone missing.
events.quote: currently a missing person, having disappeared around the same time that the archangel Avacyn

relations.note: Liliana destroyed him with the Veil.
Garruk is a relentless enemy who will hunt her.
relations.quote: she managed to make a relentless enemy who will hunt her to the ends of the Multiverse.

relations.note: Griselbrand is one of her demon masters who lays claim to her soul.
relations.quote: lays claim to her soul and commands her devotion.
a figure of worship to the secret cult known as the Skirsdag
